stories.title: Democrat Scott Colom Flips Mississippi Senate Seat In Historic Upset
stories.summary: Democrat Scott Colom defeated Republican incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi’s closely contested US Senate race, with the Associated Press calling the contest after he led 49.2% to 48.7%. The result makes Colom the state’s first Democratic senator since 1982 and its first Black US senator since Reconstruction, while giving Democrats their eighth Senate pickup of the midterm elections.

stories.title: Mandatory AI safety and security protections announced after OpenAI breach of Medicare – video
stories.summary: Australia will establish a new AI safety regulator and consider six mandatory obligations for AI companies following an OpenAI-related breach of Medicare. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said the government accepted all 18 recommendations from the review and had begun implementing them, including work on mandatory reporting.

stories.title: ‘There is no inevitable dystopia’: Jeanette Winterson on AI and the future of humanity
stories.summary: Author Jeanette Winterson argues that humanity is at a turning point with artificial intelligence but that a dystopian outcome is not inevitable.
